Parking, vehicles and guests

One stall per unit. Tenants register their own vehicle, a loaner, or a regular visitor. You get an email each time something is registered or changed.

Parking lot

Stalls 1–8 and 11–18 belong to the unit with the same number. Click a stall to see who parks there that day. Yellow = switched for a while; striped = held for a guest or contractor.

Record a switch

Two units agreed (in person or by phone) to trade stalls. Takes effect at once; both units are emailed. Occupants can also ask each other in their portals.

Stalls on the map (add, label, move guest and contractor stalls)

Row and position place a stall on the map (row 1 = top, position 1 = left). Unit stalls keep their number; you can only move them. A guest or contractor stall taken off the map keeps its history.

Guest requests

Overnight guests and guest parking, from the tenant and owner portals. Every request needs your decision; the requester is emailed. For parking, hand over a decal and record its number here. The lease allows a guest 13 overnight nights in 12 months; approving past that is the landlord's written consent.
